thin_warning: Round rails/rungs/hoops have tangential slice warnings; surface grilles/roof lips may be below 0.8mm. All failures retained. Large connected masses can mask fine parts, so bounded local checks supplement global slices, but are not a global minimum-normal-wall proof.
limitations: No structural, bridge-span, slicer, support-removal or actual-print certification. White walls are closed solid exterior masses and dark windows/doors are attached relief, not interior rooms or real glass. Dimensions, bar counts and sheet pitch are inferred and simplified.
